title: A62 NFR Register row
description: Schema for one row of analysis/canonical/core_controls/A62_nfr_register.csv (Phase 3, US-S6-01). An NFR row captures a non-functional requirement (performance / availability / scalability / security / usability / compliance / maintainability / observability / portability) extracted from upstream A59 claims. Producer: bsa-nfr-collector. Consumers: bsa-story-writer (links NFRs into story acceptance criteria), bsa-test-scenario-builder (turns measurable NFRs into automated test targets), bsa-traceability-matrix. Invariants: INV-09 (measurability — see x-bsa-measurability-rules).

NFRID.description: Stable identifier NFR-NNN or NFR-XXX-NNN (category-prefixed, e.g., NFR-PERF-001). Same shape conventions as A51Ref / ClaimID.

NFRCategory.description: ISO/IEC 25010-style quality attribute. Closed enum. Categories performance/availability/scalability require Metric+Target (see INV-09); others may omit but MUST populate TestabilityNotes.

Statement.description: The NFR text in plain language. Must be non-empty. Typical shape: '<subject> SHALL <quality> under <conditions>' (e.g., 'The order-submission API SHALL respond within 500ms at the 95th percentile under 50 concurrent users').

SourceClaimIDs.description: Non-empty semicolon/slash-separated list of upstream A59 ClaimIDs this NFR derives from. Required per INV-08 (NFRs without claim provenance are drift). Category-prefixed IDs accepted.

MeasurabilityType.description: quantitative = has numeric metric + target; qualitative = defined by policy/checklist; hybrid = has both a numeric target AND a qualitative gate (e.g., 'p95 < 500ms AND accessibility audit PASS').

Metric.description: Name of the measurable quantity (e.g., 'p95 latency ms', 'availability percentage', 'requests per second'). Required non-empty for MeasurabilityType=quantitative OR hybrid; may be empty for qualitative.

Target.description: Target value with units (e.g., '< 500', '>= 99.9', '> 100'). Required non-empty for MeasurabilityType=quantitative OR hybrid; may be empty for qualitative.

TestabilityNotes.description: How to verify the NFR. Required non-empty regardless of MeasurabilityType — an NFR with no verification path is an aspiration, not a requirement. Examples: 'k6 load test with 50 VUs', 'WCAG 2.1 AA audit by accessibility team', 'SOC2 control C-04 quarterly review'.

Criticality.description: level-1 = must-have for launch; level-2 = important but post-launch acceptable; level-3 = nice-to-have / future. Aligns with A59.Criticality semantics.

A51Ref.description: Optional. Populated when the NFR derivation surfaced an unresolved / contradicted / decision-needed item — routes through A51 in the usual way.

x-bsa-csv-columns-order._comment: Canonical column order for diff stability.

x-bsa-uniqueness-rules._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.12 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_uniqueness_rules. Schema-agnostic generic extension (see v1.2.10 CHANGELOG). NFRs are per-requirement; duplicates would break A70.RelatedNFRIDs + A71.RelatedNFRID cross-references. Pre-v1.2.12 duplicate NFRIDs were caught only at fixture-review time; v1.2.12 makes it mechanical at hook time.
x-bsa-uniqueness-rules.rationale: Without this rule, duplicate NFRID values could land at promote-gate + silently break every downstream cross-reference. NFRID is the row-identifier.

x-bsa-foreign-key-refs._comment: EXECUTABLE at the F5 hook layer as of v1.2.13 via governance/schemas/write_validator.py::_apply_foreign_key_refs. Schema-agnostic cross-artifact FK resolution. Pre-v1.2.13 the existing per-row extensions checked whether these columns were non-blank (INV-01 / INV-08 / INV-10 etc.) but did NOT check resolution against the sibling artifact at hook time; v1.2.13 closes the gap. Parallel to A72's A72-specific x-bsa-foreign-key-rules (which also includes claim_source_consistency).

foreign_keys.rationale: Multi-valued FK: NFR rows derive from one or more A59 claims. Delimiters per convention: ; / whitespace. Optional-when-blank because an NFR row may be A51-routed via A51Ref with no direct claim backing.
When the NFR is deferred / uncertain, A51Ref must resolve.

x-bsa-measurability-rules._comment: INV-09 cross-field rules enforced by bsa-nfr-collector's own validator (not by json-schema directly because the rule is category-conditional). F5 write-validator catches the per-row schema shape; bsa-nfr-collector catches the category-conditional semantics.
x-bsa-measurability-rules.rationale: An NFR with no metric, no target, and no testability notes is an aspiration — it cannot be validated or used to drive test-scenario-builder output.
